description:
In the once peaceful Goat Village, Woo I-ram suddenly became a cursed omen.

Shunned and burdened with despair, she made a decision—
to end it all by seeking out a wolf to devour her.

But there was just one problem…

This wolf wasn’t normal.

As she embarks on a journey toward what she believes to be the perfect death,
I-ram begins to question everything.

Can she find a reason to live… in the last place she expected?
